query: Cal/OSHA 2320.5 re-energizing equipment after lockout remove locks and tags

results.query: Cal/OSHA 2320.5 re-energizing equipment after lockout remove locks and tags
results.snippet: (a) An authorized person shall be responsible for the following before energizing equipment or systems which have been de-energized: (1) Determining that all persons are clear from hazards which might result from the equipment or systems being energized. (2) Removing locking devices and tags.
results.title: California Code of Regulations, Title 8, Section 2320.5. Energizing (or Re-Energizing) Equipment or Systems.
